latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of excalidraw-canvas:

- Create and render Excalidraw diagrams as PNG images via API.
- Supports basic shapes (rectangle, ellipse, diamond), text, arrows, lines, and freehand drawing.
- Returns both PNG image and an editable Excalidraw link with each render.
- Detailed documentation and usage examples included.
